SpawnConfig type reference:

  6
    Infantry: 6 soldiers in one group

  "UK3CB_ARD_O_BMP1"
    Single vehicle, always this class

  ["UK3CB_ARD_O_T72BM", "UK3CB_ARD_O_T72A", "UK3CB_ARD_O_T72B"]
    Random pick — one vehicle chosen per wave

  [["UK3CB_ARD_O_T72BM", "UK3CB_ARD_O_BMP1"]]
    Fixed convoy: T72BM leads, BMP1 follows — same group

  [[["UK3CB_ARD_O_T72BM","UK3CB_ARD_O_T72A"], "UK3CB_ARD_O_BMP1"]]
    Convoy: random T72 variant leads, BMP1 follows

  [["UK3CB_ARD_O_T72BM","UK3CB_ARD_O_BMP1"], ["UK3CB_ARD_O_T72A","UK3CB_ARD_O_BMP2"]]
    Random convoy: picks convoy A or convoy B each wave

  [["UK3CB_ARD_O_T72BM","UK3CB_ARD_O_BMP1"], "UK3CB_ARD_O_Ural_Zu23"]
    Mixed pool: each wave either spawns the convoy or a single Zu-23 truck

Convoy rules:
  - All vehicles placed in one AI group, hunt in COLUMN formation
  - Vehicles spaced 20 m apart behind the spawn object (aligned to its direction)
  - Transports (no gunner seats) auto-fill with cargo infantry (capped by GOL_MaxCargoSeats)
  - Within a convoy, each position can be a String (fixed) or Array of strings (random slot)

Magazine formats:

- primaryWeaponMags/handgunMags = ["MagClass", count]
- primaryWeaponMags/handgunMags = ["MagClassA","MagClassB", ...]

Identity order:
- _identity is applied first

- _rank is applied last

GW_Common_fnc_spawnGroup.description: Spawns a group from structured nested arrays (GW Copy format). Infantry, vehicles with crew, and waypoints are all defined by nested sub-arrays.

params.name: _unitArray
params.description: Array of infantry units. Each element: [position, direction, unitPosOrStance, specials, role]. position: [x,y,z] ATL. direction: NUMBER (compass). unitPosOrStance: STRING stance ("Auto"/"Up"/"Middle"/"Down") or ARRAY (empty = no stance lock). specials: ARRAY of [switchID, value] attribute pairs (see setAttributes). role: STRING (optional) — "r","sl","ftl","ar","g","ag","mat","mmg","ab","fac","crew","p","officer","marksman","lr","aa","pl".

params.name: _vehicleArray
params.description: Array of vehicles. Each element: [classname, position, direction, crewList, specials]. classname: STRING vehicle class. position: [x,y,z] ATL (z>20 = FLY). direction: NUMBER. crewList: ARRAY of seat assignments — each ["driver"/"gunner"/"commander"/"turret"/"cargo", seatIndex, turretPath] (empty [] = auto-fill commander+gunner+turrets). specials: ARRAY of [switchID, value] pairs (optional).

params.name: _waypointArray
params.description: Array of waypoints. Each element: [position, attributes]. position: [x,y,z]. attributes: ARRAY of [typeID, setting] pairs — 0: waypointType (STRING), 1: behaviour, 2: combatMode, 3: completionRadius (NUMBER), 4: formation, 5: speed, 6: timeout, 7: statements. Empty [] = static group (PATH disabled, LAMBS groupAI disabled).

params.name: _side
params.description: Faction side (west/east/independent/civilian). Also accepts string: "west","east","independent","civilian".

params.name: _skipQueue
params.description: Skip the spawn queue system (spawn immediately even if another group is spawning)

params.name: _skipDelays
params.description: Skip per-unit sleep delays during spawning (faster but may cause issues with large groups)
